what: Slack failure log append is not required to redact captured output
scenario_or_breakage: The new wrapper captures Slack stdout/stderr and appends it to execution-issues.md; that file flows into committed run logs, so webhook or token-like text surfaced by the Slack helper can be preserved without the existing append-failure redaction backstop
suggested_fix: Add --redact to the Slack run-log append-failure call and keep the fix limited to that append path
